defects_are_synthetic: An E0 defect is a perturbation THIS STUDY injected into a sound published manuscript. No number in this file asserts that any real paper contains an error. Manuscripts appear only as opaque labels.
what_this_is: Source-of-truth manifest. Every manuscript macro, its frozen value, the canonical record it came from, and how it can be reproduced from the public release.

routes.recomputable: computable from the public data files in docs/data/
routes.audited_aggregate: carried as a published aggregate; the underlying observations cannot safely be released
routes.mixed: parts of this value take different routes
